title: an allowlist key written as [] restricts nothing, like an absent one
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories (allowlists are open unless a list restricts)
intent: A project can compose and launch a build before it writes any allowlist. An open list still needs a value: a model, effort or tool that is empty is a problem that names the rule, never the value.

files..jitso/briefs/brief.md:
## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Do not change any file and do not leave the repository.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
